slots.title: A Nasdaq-listed company may sell $450 million bitcoin, citing Binance hack and quantum fears
slots.author: CoinDesk
slots.summary: Next Technology Holding cited exchange security and quantum computing risks in authorizing sales or loans against its 5,833 BTC. It says none of the coins are held at Binance.

slots.title: Texas brothers sentenced to 15 years in prison for armed crypto robbery, kidnapping
slots.author: Cointelegraph
slots.summary: Home invasions became the most common form of crypto wrench attacks worldwide during the first half of 2026, rising to 20 incidents from one.

slots.title: 18 years in, what has Bitcoin truly done?
slots.author: CoinDesk
slots.summary: The Bitcoin white paper achieved a lot of what Satoshi Nakamoto set out to accomplish, but the cultural impact it had may outweigh Bitcoin itself, writes CoinDesk's Nikhilesh De.

slots.title: The $6.3 billion Binance hack paradox: Centralization made the hack possible, but also saved $3 billion
slots.author: CoinDesk
slots.summary: The Binance hack has revived debates about whether decentralization is the digital asset industry’s greatest security advantage or its biggest point of weakness.

slots.title: As big bitcoin miners chase AI profits, individuals get another shot at the rewards
slots.author: CoinDesk
slots.summary: Several companies offer access to bitcoin mining without the hassle of running equipment, but high costs and the 2028 reward halving make profits uncertain.
slots.reason: A major development affecting both AI and blockchain

slots.title: Bitcoin turns 18: Has the original rebel grown up?
slots.author: Cointelegraph
slots.summary: In typical Bitcoin style, the number one cryptocurrency turns 18 today, amid AI-driven security threats, quantum fears and the biggest exchange hack in crypto history.
slots.reason: Outside your usual reads — worth a skim
